preview.text: South Korea and Indonesia meet in a T20 match at Yeonhui Cricket Ground, following nine previous recorded T20 meetings where South Korea won 2 and Indonesia won 7. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 0 per cent chance of rain and about 18 degrees.

summary.text: In IDN innings 122-7, Kavin Neeraj Chaddha was the top scorer with 50 off 53 balls, while Aamir Lal took 2 for 15. SKR replied with 123-3, led by Balage Dilruksha c & wk who scored 70 off 53 balls, as Kadek Gamantika claimed 2 for 20 to help South Korea win by 7 wkts.
